packageRules.description: symfony/mcp-bundle pins the mcp/sdk minor (0.14 needs ^0.8.1, 0.15 needs ^0.9), so neither updates alone; separate PRs fail composer resolution (#842, #859, fixed together in #918).

scheb/2fa-totp and scheb/2fa-backup-code require exactly the scheb/2fa-bundle version they were released with, so none of the three updates alone: every single-package branch fails composer resolution (measured with 8.8.0).
semgrep ships wheels for CPython 3.10-3.14 only; its pinned ruamel.yaml.clib has no cp315 wheel, so the Scan PHP job cannot install on 3.15. Lift once semgrep supports 3.15.
Stay on the MariaDB 12.3 LTS line (supported until 2029-06-12) instead of the rolling 13.x releases. Patch and digest updates of 12.3 still arrive. Raise this when the next LTS line is out.
